class.name: PhysXHaboobFront3D
class.brief_description: The billowing head of a dust storm's gust front near the camera, drawn in NVIDIA Flow.
class.description: Reads the dust layer of the active [WeatherMap3D] (its head share, see [method WeatherMap3D.get_dust_head_at]) round [member follow_target], finds where the front runs within [member near_range], and lays [member emitter_count] emitters along its crest. They push dust forward and up with the front in a [PhysXFlow3D] of its own, so the density current's head rolls into billows close up while the weather's wall draws it far away. The points are found again twice a second and travel with the front between scans. Draws nothing while no front is near.

method.name: get_flow
method.description: The Flow volume the billows are drawn in, or [code]null[/code] before the node enters the tree.

method.name: get_front_point
method.description: Front point [param index] on the ground, in world space. Zero past [method get_front_point_count].

method.name: get_front_point_count
method.description: How many points the front has near the target now; zero while no front is in range.

method.name: get_front_velocity
method.description: The front's travel at point [param index] along the ground, in m/s. Zero past [method get_front_point_count].

method.name: scan_now
method.description: Finds the front again now instead of at the next scan.

members.member: The dust's colour in the billows.
How many emitters line the front, up to 16.
Draws the billows. Off, the front is not searched and nothing is emitted.
The Flow grid cell in metres.
The node, usually the camera, round which the front is searched. Without it, the viewport's current camera.
How far from the target the front is searched and how long a stretch of it is drawn (1.6 times this), in metres.
A terrain to set the front points on. Without it, the world's ground contract, or the weather map's ground height.
